lastText: The Case Is ClosedA Name on the MoorNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 56SIR HENRY BASKERVILLE DEAD: THE BASKERVILLE CURSE?A telegram goes to Canada, and a stone goes up in the Baskerville vault, and the name is added to a list that already has too many on it. The coroner brings in a verdict of death by misadventure. It is not misadventure. It is a thing that you saw, and could not stop, by about a second. You go back to London and shut yourself in your rooms for a week, and Watson does not ask any questions.
